# Agentized

> AI agent consulting and services. This file lists pages on this site that are
> structured for machine reading, per the llms.txt convention.

## Pages

- [Catalogue](https://www.agentized.com/catalogue): Demo product catalogue (placeholder
  items only, not real products) used to test agent/crawler discovery. Items are also
  described as visible schema.org JSON-LD (`ItemList`/`Product`) in the page source —
  read that block directly rather than parsing the rendered HTML.
